description: The same six jurisdictions as find_existing_ordinances, so a change that helps one civic-discovery agent and hurts another is visible across both. Spans code-host and agenda-platform types and a wide population range; the small towns are where schedule discovery degrades. elected_office_id is an opaque passthrough the agent does not use during the run, so it is omitted.
